caption:
Gooey Gochujang Eggs 
lazy girl breakfast | high protein | asian inspired breakfast | 15 minute recipe 

Nutrition: 
C: 9 | F: 13 | P: 14
Calories: 221 per serve without rice 
Serves 1

Ingredients
2 eggs 
1 tsp vinegar 
knobb of butter 
4-5 garlic cloves, minced 
1 tsp gochujang 
1 - 2 tbsp water to thin consistency 
black pepper 
salt, to taste if you need it ( i usually dont add any )
1/2 - 1 cup cooked rice, to serve 
 
garnish: sesame seeds, spring onions, optional 

Method
start by softboiling your eggs this is my go to method 
add water to a pan and bring to a boil, add in the vinegar and the eggs to the pan and start a 6 minute timer, exact 6 minutes is the magic number, once the timer is done, add the eggs to a bowl of iced water and leave for a few minutes and peel after 

to make the sauce, to a frying pan, add in butter, garlic and saute then add in the gochujang and water to thin out, let it bubble and add in the peeled eggs and stir into the sauce 

serve over a bed of steamed rice or my lemon coriander rice ( recipe in the previous reel )
